subject.title: feat(ui): add X (Twitter) link to About page community links

question: Should the Control UI About page officially promote `https://x.com/openclaw` alongside the existing Website, Docs, GitHub, Discord, and Changelog destinations?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically consistent, but selecting an official social destination is a maintainer-owned product and communications choice; the protected `maintainer` label prevents automated cleanup from deciding it.

options.title: Confirm and merge
options.body: Approve the official X destination and merge this contained UI/link/test change.

options.title: Keep the current link set
options.body: Decline adding X to the in-product About links and close the PR without changing the existing community destinations.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge
recommendation.body: Approve the official X destination and merge this contained UI/link/test change.
